items.markdown:
Leading **buyers advocates** and **acquisition advisory** specialists on the **Mornington Peninsula** focus exclusively on the purchaser's side for prestige, family, and coastal luxury real estate.[[1]](https://www.woledgehatt.com.au/buyers-advocate-melbourne/)[[2]](https://davidsonpropertyadvocates.com.au/buyers-advocate-mornington-peninsula)[[3]](https://buyerx.com.au/team/mornington-peninsula-buyers-advocate/)

### Top Buyers Advocates for Prestige Homes on the Mornington Peninsula

- **[BuyerX (Michael Sier & Jarrod Quint)](https://buyerx.com.au/team/mornington-peninsula-buyers-advocate/)** 
	- **Focus & Approach:** Operates on a low-volume, high-service model specialising in luxury coastal and acreage properties across Mount Eliza, Mornington, Mount Martha, Red Hill, Flinders, Blairgowrie, Sorrento, and Portsea.
	- **Key Credentials:** Led by Michael Sier (over 20 years of industry experience, full Victorian Real Estate Agent licence, $500M+ in career transactions).
	- **Notable Prestige Track Record:** High-value acquisitions include properties in Red Hill (up to $9M), Flinders ($6.75M), Mount Eliza ($6.175M), and Portsea ($4.3M).[[1]](https://buyerx.com.au/team/mornington-peninsula-buyers-advocate/)
- **[Davidson Property Advocates](https://davidsonpropertyadvocates.com.au/buyers-advocate-mornington-peninsula)** 
	- **Focus & Approach:** Full-service search, negotiation, auction attendance, and off-market acquisition covering the Mornington Peninsula (including Blairgowrie, Sorrento, Rye, Portsea, Flinders, and Hastings) as well as Melbourne's Bayside and Inner East.
	- **Key Credentials:** Founded by Tonya Davidson , decorated with multi-year industry honors including *REIA Australian Buyers Agent of the Year (2025)* and *3-time REIV Buyers Agent of the Year (2022–2024)*.[[1]](https://davidsonpropertyadvocates.com.au/buyers-advocate-mornington-peninsula)
- **[Woledge Hatt Buyers Advocates](https://www.woledgehatt.com.au/buyers-advocate-melbourne/)** 
	- **Focus & Approach:** Independent, exclusive buyer-side representation handling complete property searches, architectural/renovation assessments, off-market access, and auction/private-treaty negotiations.
	- **Key Credentials:** Licensed estate agents providing dedicated representation across Melbourne's prime pockets and the Mornington Peninsula luxury market.[[1]](https://www.woledgehatt.com.au/buyers-advocate-melbourne/)
- **[LP Advisory](https://lpadvisory.com.au/luxury-homes/)** 
	- **Focus & Approach:** Dedicated luxury buyer's agency servicing prestige buyers, interstate purchasers, and international clients seeking high-end residences, private inspections, and provenance checks.[[1]](https://lpadvisory.com.au/luxury-homes/)

### Comparison of Mornington Peninsula Buyer Advisory Specialists

| Agency / Advocate | Primary Peninsula Suburbs | Key Specialization | Notable Industry Accolades |
|---|---|---|---|
| **BuyerX** | Mount Eliza, Mount Martha, Red Hill, Flinders, Sorrento, Portsea | Acreage, coastal estates, and high-value off-market sourcing | Over $500M in lifetime transactions |
| **Davidson Property Advocates** | Sorrento, Blairgowrie, Portsea, Flinders, Hastings | Full search, auction tactics, and complete purchase management | REIA Australian Buyers Agent of the Year (2025) |
| **Woledge Hatt** | Peninsula-wide alongside Bayside Melbourne | Architectural appraisal, value determination, and strict buyer exclusivity | Licensed Victorian property advisory |
| **LP Advisory** | Prestige and luxury coastal enclaves | Remote/interstate/international buyer representation and due diligence | Dedicated luxury portfolio focus |
